import html # Predefined HTML structure for a blog post. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def display_blog(heading: str, description: str) -> str: """ Prepare a user‑submitted blog post for safe web display. Parameters ---------- heading : str The main headline or subject of the blog post. description : str The complete textual content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A string containing the sanitized and HTML‑formatted blog post, ready for secure presentation on the webpage. Notes ----- - All user input is escaped using ``html.escape`` to prevent injection attacks such as XSS. - The function does not perform any additional validation of length or content; such checks should be handled by the caller if needed. """ # Escape user input to neutralize any HTML/JS injection attempts safe_title = html.escape(heading, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(description, quote=True) # Render the blog post using the predefined format rendered = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body) return rendered
